name: gmail
description: Read Gmail via IMAP (app-password auth). Read-only for now.

commands.description: List recent emails from a specific sender substring
Fetch full body of email by ID (from list output)

prompt_doc: Gmail read-only via `python3 integrations/gmail/cli.py <cmd>`. Commands: `list --unread [--limit N]`, `list --today`, `list --from <name>`, `search '<gmail-query>'`, `read <id>`, `count --unread`. Output is pre-summarized one-line-per-msg. Use `read <id>` only when user asks for full body — saves tokens.
